final: SELECT AVG(employee_count) AS average_employee_count, AVG(employee_count - city_average) AS average_difference FROM (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS employee_count, (SELECT AVG(city_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM Employee WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City)) AS city_average FROM Employee WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT AVG(city_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS city_count FROM Employee WHERE City IS NOT NULL GROUP BY City))) AS kept
